title: 4 containers with 'smuggled' cigarettes found at Zambales pier

blocks.text: IBA, Zambales — Four containers of suspected smuggled cigarettes were found at an illegally constructed pier in Palauig town in Zambales province, which has been under a cease-and-desist order since 2022, authorities confirmed on Wednesday. According to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) in Zambales, an unidentified vessel unloaded the containers at BNB Pier in Sitio Luan in Barangay Lipay. The pier is located within the 7,558-hectare Masinloc and Oyon Bay Protected Landscape and Seascape (MOBPLS), a protected area spanning portions of Masinloc and Palauig.
